section.title: org.osgi.framework.connect
section.para: Framework Connect Package Version 1.0.
Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:

listitem.para: ConnectContent - A ConnectContent provides a Framework instance access to the content of a ConnectModule.
ConnectContent.ConnectEntry - Represents the entry of a ConnectContent.
ConnectFrameworkFactory - A factory for creating Framework instances.
ConnectModule - A ConnectModule is used by a Framework instance to access the content of the connected bundle.
FrameworkUtilHelper - A helper for the FrameworkUtil class.

ModuleConnector - A ModuleConnector provides connections to instances of ConnectModule that are used by a Framework instance to connect installed bundles locations with content provided by the ModuleConnector.

section.title: public interface ConnectContent
section.para: A ConnectContent provides a Framework instance access to the content of a ConnectModule.

A framework may open and close the content for a ConnectModule multiple times while the ConnectContent is in use by the framework. The framework must close the ConnectContent once the ConnectContent is no longer used as the content of a current bundle revision or an in use bundle revision.

An entry in a ConnectContent is identified by a path name that is a solidus ('/' /) separated path. A ConnectContent may treat directories as entries. A directory entry path name will end with a solidus. A directory entry may be located using a path name that omits the trailing solidus.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public static final String TAG_OSGI_CONNECT = "osgi.connect"
section.para: The osgi.identity tags attribute value used by the framework to tag connect bundle revisions.

section.title: public void close() throws IOException
section.para: Closes this ConnectContent.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an error occurred closing this ConnectContent.

section.title: public Optional<ClassLoader> getClassLoader()
section.para: Returns a class loader for this ConnectContent.

This method is called by the framework for resolved bundles only and will be called at most once while a bundle is resolved. If a bundle associated with a ConnectModule is refreshed and resolved again, the framework will ask the ConnectContent for the class loader again. This allows for a ConnectContent to reuse or create a new class loader each time the bundle revision is resolved.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Optional containing the class loader for this ConnectContent, or an empty Optional if framework should handle creating a class loader for the bundle revision associated with this ConnectContent.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this ConnectContent has been closed.

section.title: public Iterable<String> getEntries() throws IOException
section.para: Returns the entry names available in this ConnectContent.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Iterable which can supply the available entry names.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an error occurs reading this ConnectContent.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this ConnectContent has been closed.

section.title: public Optional<ConnectContent.ConnectEntry> getEntry(String path)

formalpara.title: path
formalpara.para: The path name of the entry.

section.para: Returns the ConnectEntry for the specified path name in this content.

The empty value is returned if an entry with the specified path name does not exist. The path must not start with a "/" and is relative to the root of this content. A connect entry for a directory will have a path name that ends with a slash ('/').

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Optional containing the ConnectEntry for the specified path, or an empty Optional if no entry for specified path can be found.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this ConnectContent has been closed.

section.title: public Optional<Map<String, String>> getHeaders()
section.para: Returns the Manifest headers and values of this ConnectContent.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Optional containing the Manifest headers and values for this ConnectContent, or an empty Optional if the framework should handle parsing the Manifest of the content itself.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If this ConnectContent has been closed.

section.title: public void open() throws IOException
section.para: Opens this ConnectContent.

The framework will open the content when it needs to access the content for a bundle revision associated with this ConnectContent. The framework may defer calling this method until requests to access the bundle revision content are made.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an error occurred opening this ConnectContent.

section.title: public interface ConnectFrameworkFactory
section.para: A factory for creating Framework instances.
If a framework supports ModuleConnector, then the implementation jar must contain the following resource:

This UTF-8 encoded resource must contain the name of the framework implementation's ConnectFrameworkFactory implementation class. Space and tab characters, including blank lines, in the resource must be ignored. The number sign ('#' \u0023) and all characters following it on each line are a comment and must be ignored.

Launchers can find the name of the ConnectFrameworkFactory implementation class in the resource and then load and construct a ConnectFrameworkFactory object for the framework implementation. The ConnectFrameworkFactory implementation class must have a public, no-argument constructor. Java™ SE 6 introduced the ServiceLoader class which can create a ConnectFrameworkFactory instance from the resource.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public Framework newFramework(Map<String, String> configuration, ModuleConnector moduleConnector)

formalpara.title: configuration
formalpara.para: The framework properties to configure the new framework instance. If framework properties are not provided by the configuration argument, the created framework instance must use some reasonable default configuration appropriate for the current VM. For example, the system packages for the current execution environment should be properly exported. The specified configuration argument may be null. The created framework instance must copy any information needed from the specified configuration argument since the configuration argument can be changed after the framework instance has been created.

formalpara.title: moduleConnector
formalpara.para: The module connector that the new framework instance will use. The specified module connector argument may be null.

section.para: Create a new Framework instance using the specified module connector.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A new, configured Framework instance. The framework instance must be in the Bundle.INSTALLED state.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: SecurityException– If the caller does not have AllPermission, and the Java Runtime Environment supports permissions.

section.title: public interface ConnectModule
section.para: A ConnectModule is used by a Framework instance to access the content of the connected bundle.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public ConnectContent getContent() throws IOException
section.para: Returns the current content of this connect module.

The framework must call this method when it needs to access the content for the current bundle revision of this ConnectModule. The framework may defer opening the returned ConnectContent until requests to access the bundle revision content are made.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The current ConnectContent of this ConnectModule.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an error occurred getting the content.

section.title: public interface FrameworkUtilHelper
section.para: A helper for the FrameworkUtil class.
This helper provides alternative implementations for methods on FrameworkUtil.

section.title: public Optional<Bundle> getBundle(Class<?> classFromBundle)

formalpara.title: classFromBundle
formalpara.para: A class associated with a bundle.

section.para: Returns the Bundle associated with the specified class.
This helper method is called by FrameworkUtil.getBundle(Class) if the standard implementation of FrameworkUtil is unable to find the bundle.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Optional containing the Bundle for the specified class, or an empty Optional if the specified class is not from a bundle.

section.title: public interface ModuleConnector
section.para: A ModuleConnector provides connections to instances of ConnectModule that are used by a Framework instance to connect installed bundles locations with content provided by the ModuleConnector.

This allows a ModuleConnector to provide content and classes for a connected bundle installed in the Framework. A ModuleConnector is provided when creating a framework instance. Because a ModuleConnector instance can participate in the initialization of the Framework and the life cycle of a Framework instance the ModuleConnector instance should only be used with a single Framework instance at a time.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public Optional<ConnectModule> connect(String location) throws BundleException

formalpara.title: location
formalpara.para: The bundle location used to install a bundle.

section.para: Connects a bundle location with a ConnectModule.

When the result is empty, then the framework must handle reading the content of the bundle itself. Otherwise, the returned ConnectModule must be used by the framework to access the content of the bundle.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Optional containing the ConnectModule for the specified bundle location, or an empty Optional if the framework must handle reading the content of the bundle itself.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: BundleException– If the location cannot be handled.

section.title: public void initialize(File storage, Map<String, String> configuration)

formalpara.title: storage
formalpara.para: The persistent storage area used by the Framework or null if the platform does not have file system support.

formalpara.title: configuration
formalpara.para: An unmodifiable map of framework configuration properties that were used to configure the new framework instance.

section.para: Initializes this ModuleConnector with the framework persistent storage file and framework properties configured for a Framework instance.
This method is called once by a Framework instance and is called before any other methods on this module connector are called.

section.title: public Optional<BundleActivator> newBundleActivator()
section.para: Creates a new activator for this ModuleConnector.
This method is called by the framework during framework initialization. Returning an activator allows this ModuleConnector to participate in the framework life cycle. If an activator is returned:

listitem.para: The framework will call the activator's start method prior to activating any extension bundles.
The framework will call the activator's stop method after deactivating any extension bundles.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An Optional containing a new BundleActivator for this ModuleConnector, or an empty Optional if no BundleActivator is necessary.
